The '''Baroban Warehouse''' was located in the [[Twin Suns mining compound]], in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[3643 BBY]], [[Bull]] "The Unbreakable" was hired by [[Jundo Martik]] to recover stolen ore and drive off the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]]. When Bull and his associates failed to return after a few days, a group of Republic spacers was sent by Jundo Martik to reclaim the mine and the warehouse. Bull and the other mercenaries attempted to frame the spacers for the theft of the ore, but were killed by the droid [[ST-97]].<ref name="TOR" />
